_demand_record.unit: gross passenger boardings / one-way passenger-trips across both directions/year
_demand_record.method: Arithmetic sum of the 12 published AGETRANSP 2023 monthly totals for the exact named line. Bidirectional line total; one boarding equals one one-way passenger-trip. No doubling, halving, terminal allocation, or daily annualization.

_fare_record.method: BRL 5.00 published line tariff divided by Banco Central do Brasil PTAX sell rate 5.1329 BRL/USD dated 2026-07-09. Passenger-facing benchmark only; not claimed as operator realized yield, paid-fare mix, subsidy receipt, or audited route revenue. Model premium re-fare rule may lift this benchmark for premium-service planning.

_premium_substitute_fare_record.basis: Uber Black-equivalent premium ride-hail seat fare for the Rio/Niterói cross-bay market. Navier serves an otherwise-subsidized public-ferry crossing only as a premium on-demand electric water-taxi, so it prices against the premium road alternative, never the subsidized public ferry.
_premium_substitute_fare_record.method: UberX Rio<->Niteroi observed average ~R$63-73; Uber Black premium multiple ~2.1x -> ~R$143; converted at BRL/USD 5.07 (2026-07) -> ~USD 28. Rounded premium-substitute planning benchmark; not a claimed operator realized yield.
_premium_substitute_fare_record._decision: Jaideep explicit override 2026-07-15: premium-tier substitute (Uber Black), not basic/commuter fare. Prior $18 global premium floor was wrong for Brazil. Shared canonical basis across DiDi Brazil and inDrive Brazil.
